description: Comptages routiers en France is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by NosCandidats -. Ongoing compilation of data. Coverage: NosCandidats -. The portal shows the English title as "Road counts in France" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is NosCandidats -. The listing shows 6 download or service links in HTML. The listing shows 2016-03-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
